fusions.name: Bulwark Rush
fusions.desc: You rush up to 5 tiles to the target and drive your scales into it, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that from the full 5 tiles. It is left with [Slow Learner] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hammered Seam
fusions.desc: A tail slam that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Steel Under Keratin
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 28 damage for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Lamellar Lock
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour is 6% higher at all times.
